authority.owner_confirmed: Selected directions and foundation owner-decisions.json control; numerical/protocol defaults remain proposed unless explicitly recorded.

identity.listing_key: Canonical listing plus venue/MIC; ticker alone is not globally unique. Real identifiers, synthetic observations.
identity.aliases: Effective-dated and source-specific, with ambiguity states.

numbers.amounts: Finite decimal strings; quantities and prices carry explicit scales/units. Do not use binary float as financial ledger truth.
numbers.money_currency: ISO currency, with quote unit separate; GBX quotes normalise into GBP units via explicit 1/100 factor.
numbers.rounding: Policy/scale/rounding/residual tolerances are proposed in financial lane and require their own approval.

fx.no_silent_inverse_or_latest: Historical calculations pin the defined dated FX policy; no future FX or unlabeled latest-value substitution.

time.timestamps: UTC aware timestamps plus exchange IANA timezone/session/calendar version; dates and instants are distinct.
time.known_at: Conservative MP availability for prospective use: at least ingestion and evidenced publication when both exist.
time.cutoff_rule: Every feature cites information available by its task cutoff under the declared operational or vintage-backed replay policy.
time.published_at: Evidenced source publication of the specific vintage; unknown remains explicit.
time.replay_available_at: Separate historical-availability evidence/policy; never rewrites actual ingestion or prospective known_at.
time.cash_flow_dates: Forecast calendar rolling never changes actual ledger cash-flow dates or the declared XIRR year-fraction convention.

price_basis.ledger: Raw normalised prices plus explicitly booked cash income/fees; no dividend double counting with total-return adjusted inputs.
price_basis.forecast: Each task pins raw/adjusted/total-return/NAV basis and transformations. NAV and market close are distinct truths.
price_basis.total_return: Declare income/reinvestment/actions/FX conventions. No owner contributions in an instrument total-return target unless a separate simulation task says so.

states.separation: These dimensions are not collapsed into one confidence percentage. Numeric value remains absent when the calculation is unsupported.

publication.ledger: Readers pin owner/environment revision head and consume published manifests only; staging/GSI/Streams is not completeness authority.
publication.corrections: Append superseding financial/source/outcome evidence; do not overwrite original predictions or approvals.
publication.atomicity: S3 and DynamoDB are not one atomic transaction; financial visibility/audit/outbox is specified explicitly.

science.targets: Terminal return/loss, probability of positive/excess return, running-peak maximum drawdown, origin-relative adverse excursion and cost-basis loss are distinct.
science.ground_truth: Canonical realised matured outcomes, not LLM confidence.
science.qualification: Baselines first; bounded challengers/factor ablations; train-fold-only transforms and chronological evidence; owner promotion.

budget.scope: Combined MP dev/prod AWS, data and Claude/evals; not per account.
budget.anthropic_credit: Shared user-reported unverified pool, counted once; no automatic uncovered/unverifiable paid calls.
budget.dev_data: Synthetic default; Basic live candidate uses actual shared weighted minute/day limits. No quota multiplication by worker/key/environment.
